description: Database patterns and pitfalls for Drizzle ORM with SQLite/libSQL

patterns.title: Drizzle config relative path for DATABASE_URL
patterns.problem: drizzle.config.ts runs from packages/db/, but DATABASE_URL is relative to project root or apps/server
patterns.solution: Use file: prefix with absolute path in .env, or configure dotenv to load from correct location

patterns.title: Turso dialect for local SQLite with cloud option
patterns.problem: Need local SQLite development with option for Turso cloud in production
patterns.solution: Use dialect: 'turso' which supports both local file: URLs and Turso cloud connections

patterns.title: Schema tests without database connection
patterns.problem: Testing database package exports requires DATABASE_URL which isn't available in CI/test env
patterns.solution: Test schema exports and column definitions only - avoid importing db client in unit tests

patterns.title: JSON column with text mode for flexible settings
patterns.problem: Need to store flexible key-value settings in SQLite without strict schema
patterns.solution: Use text column with mode: 'json' and $type<> for TypeScript inference
patterns.context7Query: drizzle sqlite json column text mode

patterns.title: Follow existing schema file patterns exactly
patterns.problem: New schema files can diverge from project conventions causing inconsistencies
patterns.solution: Copy import style, timestamp patterns, index naming from existing schema files (e.g., auth.ts)

patterns.title: Complex JSON column typing with nested objects
patterns.problem: Storing nested JSON objects (arrays of objects, nested properties) requires proper TypeScript typing
patterns.solution: Use $type<> with full interface definition for complex JSON structures

patterns.title: Index strategy for state machine columns
patterns.problem: Tables with status columns are frequently filtered by status (state machine queries)
patterns.solution: Create indexes on status columns and any other columns used for grouping/filtering

pitfalls.title: drizzle-kit migrate fails with relative path
pitfalls.error: ConnectionFailed("Unable to open connection to local database .nomos/nomos.db: 14")
pitfalls.cause: Relative DATABASE_URL path is resolved from packages/db/, not project root
pitfalls.prevention: Use absolute paths or file: prefix with full path for SQLite databases
